verdict.rationale: Salv's sanctions screening product screens customers at onboarding, re-screens them automatically as lists change, and supports on-demand screening via API. It offers configurable fuzzy or exact matching, transliteration, and Custom Lists configurable through the API. The evidence does not show that a compliance officer can choose which sanctions or watchlists to screen against, and it does not distinguish screening of companies from individuals. missing for 10: documented selection of specific sanctions/watchlist sources, explicit coverage of legal entities/companies alongside individuals, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen individuals and companies against selected sanctions and watchlists

citations.quote: Customers are screened at onboarding, then re-screened automatically several times a day as lists change, and on demand through the API.
Choose matching per field: fuzzy for names, where spelling varies, with a threshold you set; exact for an account number
some of the configuration is available in open API as well: Custom Lists
